description: The plot illustrates the relationship between training loss and FLOPs for different methods compared to a Vanilla method. The x-axis is labeled “FLOPs (x10^12)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled “Loss Ratio” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 10. There are five lines displayed on the plot. The first, a green solid line representing “Vanilla”, begins at approximately 100 at a FLOPs value of 0 and remains at 100 across the entire x-axis range. The second, a red dashed line representing “SepLLM(n=360)”, starts at approximately 75 at a FLOPs value of 0, decreases to approximately 35 at a FLOPs value of 80. The third, a blue dashed line representing “SepLLM(n=256)”, begins at approximately 70 at a FLOPs value of 0, and decreases to approximately 30 at a FLOPs value of 80. The fourth, a cyan solid line representing “StreamLLM(n=64)”, starts at approximately 72 at a FLOPs value of 0, and decreases to approximately 25 at a FLOPs value of 80. The fifth, a magenta solid line representing “StreamLLM(n=32)”, begins at approximately 78 at a FLOPs value of 0, and decreases to approximately 30 at a FLOPs value of 80.
